biggest_catch: No stated end date — 'limited time offer' only — and the $150 tier requires $2,000 in recurring payroll/pension/government direct deposits within 90 days; you cannot earn both tiers (you get the higher one only).
catches: No stated expiry date — 'limited time offer' only; verify the promo is live before opening.

Two tiers, one bonus only: $100 for opening a new Free Checking for Life account with a minimum opening deposit of $500; $150 requires satisfying the $100 requirements PLUS recurring direct deposit(s) totaling $2,000+ within 90 days. Eligible customers who meet both receive the higher amount, NOT both.
Qualifying recurring direct deposit = ACH credit for payroll, pension, or government payments (e.g. Social Security).
Accounts must be open and funded within 90 days of account opening; bonus posted after the 90-day qualifying period concludes.
Use promo code FREECASH when opening online.
Not valid for individuals with an existing Embassy Bank checking account or anyone who previously received a new account bonus from Embassy.
Limit one bonus per household; bonus may be subject to 1099 tax reporting.
Free Checking for Life has no monthly maintenance fee and no minimum balance requirement beyond the $500 opening deposit for the bonus.
Embassy Bank is a Lehigh Valley (PA) community bank — 10 locations; online opening available, but service area is local.
